input_layout: NCHW RGB normalised with ImageNet mean/std (0-1 range)
preprocess_steps: convert to RGB and resize to 288x288
caveats: The unaugmented OriginalDataset has filenames that suggest multiple ~2mm-apart slices from the same MRI scan land in different files (e.g. '26 (19).jpg', '26 (20).jpg'). A random stratified split puts adjacent slices from the same scan into both train and val, so the reported macro-F1 reflects image-level CV not patient-level CV. Published patient-grouped baselines on the OASIS-1 source upstream of Kaggle land in the 80-90% accuracy range, not 99%. Treat as a strong demo, not a clinical claim.
ModerateDemented has only 13 val samples; per-class metrics for that class have very wide error bars and should not be quoted in isolation.
Brain MRI scans are not what this app's webcam captures - this model is only useful as an 'upload an MRI' demo flow, not passive monitoring.
